eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Bay; Calhoun; Escambia; Gulf; Holmes; Jackson; Okaloosa; Santa Rosa; Walton; Washington, FL; at 9:29 AM on AUG 28, 2021 Effective until 11:29 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Florida AMBER Alert has been issued for Teddy Jones Jr., a black male, 2 years old, 2 feet 8 inches tall, 37 pounds, black hair and black eyes, who was last seen wearing a t-shirt and diaper, and Shantese Jones, a black female, 2 years old, 2 feet 8 inches tall, 30 pounds, black hair and black eyes, who was last seen wearing a t-shirt and diaper. Teddy and Shantese both have curly hair. The children were last seen in the area of the 1000 block of Everitt Avenue in Panama City, Florida. The children may be in the company of Teddy Jones, a black male, 6 feet tall, 155 pounds, black hair and brown eyes. He has a large tattoo on his left forearm. They may be traveling in a 2007, black, Honda Accord, FL tag number, QKTU5 8. The back passenger window has three or four strips of duct tape at the top.  If located, DO NOT APPROACH. Contact law enforcement immediately. If you have any information on the whereabouts of these children, please contact the Panama City Police Department at 850-872-3112, or 911.#FL AMBER.
